result.reasoning: This commit refactored PageManager's page-pop logic to support per-page transition animations. It moved the removal of the view (`mContainerView.removeView`) and the `mCurPage = prevPage` assignment out of the immediate synchronous path and into `doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal`, which is only invoked after the animation delay (via postDelayed) when an animation plays. This means `mCurPage` was not nulled/updated immediately when the page was popped if a transition animation was involved — precisely the bug the fix commit addresses by moving `mContainerView.removeView(...)` and `mCurPage = prevPage` back to execute immediately, regardless of whether an animation plays.
